claim: In November 2024 SQS increased the in-flight limit for FIFO queues: with enough publish throughput, you can now process up to 120K messages at a time, where the limit was 20K. The FIFO quota page now says FIFO queues support a maximum of 120,000 in-flight messages.
question: What is the in-flight message limit of an SQS FIFO queue, and what was it before November 2024?

qualifiers.condition: an increase beyond the limit can be requested from AWS Support

evidence.quote: FIFO queues support a maximum of 120,000 in-flight messages (messages received by a consumer but not yet deleted).
If you have sufficient publish throughput and were constrained by the 20K in-flight limit, you can now process up to 120K messages at a time by scaling your receivers.

note: d112. The What's New page itself is blocked by robots.txt; the quote is from the saved What's New feed (api/whats-new-v2-amazon-sqs). Current-truth numbers fact: sqs-in-flight-fifo-limit. Standard queues are approximately 120,000 in flight.
